page.overview:
What is Toedscool?

Toedscool resembles a Tentacool in most aspects, except its body is pink, the orbs on its head are yellow, and its tentacles are white and have "feet". The flaps above its lower body can fall off and have a chewy and delicious taste, making them used in recipes such as pickles.

Toedscool lives in humid forests and clings onto tree roots.

Toedscool is able to run at a speed of 30 miles per hour (50 kilometres and hour) using its spindly legs.

Toedscool evolves into Toedscruel starting at level 30.
